firstError.observed: The requested server was activated and passed the real connectivity probe, but the response body combined progress text with JSON and was not valid JSON for the browser client.
firstError.impact: The browser rejected the successful activation response, did not refresh the server list, and presented the operation as failed.

additionalConfirmedFailures.cause: home.js renders servers.activeServerId instead of resolving the matching server name
home snapshot embeds the Xray status envelope at xray.data, while home.js reads xray.version
home.html has no version element and home.js does not request api/broray/info.cgi
api/xray/update-check.cgi invokes an unsupported broray xray update-check command
the internal candidate has no configured signed release-index URL, so the exposed control returns INDEX_VERIFY_FAILED
the UI hardcodes the subscription name, deletes without confirmation, and uses an incomplete simplified presentation
